description: This file defines the KpiServiceException class within the OrangeHRM's Performance exception namespace, extending the base PHP Exception class. It includes a static method to generate a specific exception message related to KPI ratings.

classes.name: KpiServiceException
classes.description: A custom exception class for KPI service errors, providing specific methods for KPI-related exception messages.

methods.name: minGreaterThanMax
methods.description: Static method returning a new instance of KpiServiceException with a message indicating that the minimum rating should be less than the maximum rating.
